List all available datasets in cdiscdata

Source: R/list_datasets.R
list_datasets.Rd

List all available datasets in cdiscdata

Usage

list_datasets()

Value

A data frame with one row per dataset describing its type, version range, and latest available version.

Examples

list_datasets()
#>                  dataset       type ct_type
#> 1                ct_sdtm         CT    sdtm
#> 2                ct_adam         CT    adam
#> 3                ig_sdtm         IG    <NA>
